people.name: Cyrene
people.line: City in North Africa; home of early Christians

people.name: Simon
people.line: A man who carried Jesus' cross on the way to crucifixion.

translations.web: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.
translations.bsb: Along the way they found a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
translations.kjv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
translations.asv: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to go with them, that he might bear his cross.
